caption: The drawing features three views of a single chair: a front view, a side view, and a top-down section of the legs and runners. The chair is depicted in black linework on a tan or yellowed background, likely due to age or the type of paper used. The front view shows an ornate backrest with symmetrical, intricate scrollwork and a carved central motif, as well as studded detailing at the base of the seat. The side view highlights the chair’s curved armrest, which scrolls at the end, and the angled backrest supported by an upholstered seat with visible side studs, along with labeling of all critical dimensions. The section at left displays the spacing and alignment of the leg structure with horizontal rungs, also with measurements. The drawing is annotated with various dimensional figures in both horizontal and vertical orientation. In the bottom left corner, there is a note indicating "Brooklyn Museum Corbin House No 14070." The composition is technical, with all elements drawn to scale and labeled with detailed dimensions, and includes handwritten notes indicating specific measurements and construction details. There is also a blue handwritten marking on the right side of the sheet beside the chair.
title: Armchair
